int_name: N 3RD ST & W HUNTING PARK AVE

result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection with basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks, a marked crosswalk, and a pedestrian signal. However, the environment is compromised by parked cars that obstruct sightlines and faded pavement markings.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Cars parked very close to the intersection and crosswalk limit the visibility between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street along the curb near the crosswalk

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The transverse crosswalk markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the crosswalk to improve sightlines for both pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Replace faded transverse lines with continental or ladder-style markings to increase visibility.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and prevent illegal parking near the corner.

result.summary: The environment is a wide, multi-lane arterial road with faded crosswalk markings and no dedicated pedestrian signals or refuge islands. Pedestrians must cross a significant distance exposed to traffic, with sightlines partially obstructed by parked vehicles near the crossing point.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a median or refuge island, increasing exposure time.

hazards.name: Faded Markings
hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching drivers.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles on the left side of the image are positioned very close to the crosswalk, potentially hiding pedestrians from oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the roadway near the crosswalk

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to reduce the crossing distance and prevent parking too close to the crosswalk, improving sightlines.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk with high-visibility thermoplastic markings to improve driver awareness.

result.summary: The intersection features a signalized crossing with a marked zebra crosswalk and pedestrian signals. However, the environment is characterized by significantly degraded pavement and an industrial setting that lacks high-quality pedestrian amenities.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Significant cracking and uneven patching within the crosswalk area create tripping hazards for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground roadway surface within the crosswalk.

hazards.name: Faded Markings
hazards.description: The zebra crosswalk markings are worn, which may reduce their visibility to approaching motorists.

interventions.title: Roadway Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair and repave the intersection to provide a smooth, level surface for all users, eliminating tripping hazards.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Refresh
interventions.description: Apply new high-visibility thermoplastic markings to the crosswalk to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The intersection features a signalized crossing with a marked zebra crosswalk across a wide four-lane roadway in an industrial area.
